title: Free Online PDF Tools — Edit, Merge, Split & Sign
description: Edit, merge, split, compress and sign PDFs online with Folio. Free annotations and page tools, with optional paid original-text editing.
heading: A simpler way to work with PDFs.
intro: Edit, sign, merge and organize your documents in your browser. Choose a tool and get started.
englishNotice: The advanced editor and account pages currently use English.
uploadTitle: Drop your PDF and get started
uploadHint: Drag a file here, or choose one from your device. Up to 50 MB.
invalidPdf: Choose a PDF to open in the editor.
tooLarge: Choose a PDF smaller than 50 MB.
footer: A little less paperwork. A little more possibility.
local: Processed in your browser. No file upload.
cloud: Editor documents are saved to private cloud storage. Guest files expire after 24 hours.
pricingNote: Annotations and page tools are free. Downloading changes to original PDF text requires a paid plan.
faq: Adding text, annotations and visual signatures, merging, splitting and converting images to PDF are free. Downloading edits to original PDF text requires a paid plan. Free downloads do not include a Folio watermark.

Standalone merge, split, compression and image-to-PDF tools process files in your browser. The editor uploads documents to private cloud storage for recovery. Guest editor files expire after 24 hours.
Can I use Folio on my phone?
Yes. Use Folio in a browser on your phone, tablet or computer without installing software. Large PDFs may need a desktop browser with more memory.

edit-pdf.name: Edit PDF
edit-pdf.description: Add text, highlights, annotations and visual signatures to your PDF. Download your additions for free; original-text changes require a paid plan.
edit-pdf.detail: Open a PDF in the editor to add text and review pages. Supported original text can also be edited, but paragraphs do not automatically reflow. Scanned pages can be annotated; OCR is not included.
steps: Choose a PDF from your device.
Add text, annotations or a signature in the editor.
Review the pages and download your edited copy.

merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.description: Combine several PDF files into one document for free. Arrange the files in the order you need before downloading.
merge-pdf.detail: Merge up to 20 PDFs, with a maximum of 50 MB per file and 150 MB combined. Files are processed in your browser. Keep the originals: merging can affect digital signatures and interactive forms.
steps: Choose at least two PDF files.
Arrange the files using the up and down arrows.
Merge and download your combined PDF.

split-pdf.name: Split PDF
split-pdf.description: Extract selected pages into a new PDF or save each selected page as a separate file in a ZIP archive.
split-pdf.detail: Choose a page range such as 1-3, 5 or leave it blank for every page. Export the selection as one PDF or one file per page. Processing happens in your browser, and your original file stays unchanged.
steps: Choose the PDF you want to split.
Select pages and choose a PDF or ZIP output.

compress-pdf.name: Compress PDF
compress-pdf.description: Optimize PDF structure without reducing text or image resolution. Download a smaller copy when lossless optimization can save space.
compress-pdf.detail: Folio applies lossless optimization in your browser. Savings depend on the document: already optimized files may not get smaller. This tool does not downsample images or guarantee a target file size.
steps: Choose a PDF up to 50 MB.
Run lossless optimization in your browser.
Check the resulting size and download your PDF.

sign-pdf.name: Sign PDF
sign-pdf.description: Add a visual signature to a PDF in your browser. Position it on the page and download a signed copy for free.
sign-pdf.detail: Draw, type or upload a signature in the editor, then adjust its size and position. A visual signature is not a certificate-based digital signature and does not verify identity. Check the recipient’s requirements before sharing.
steps: Choose the PDF you want to sign.
Create a signature in the editor and place it on the page.
Review the document and download a copy.

image-to-pdf.name: Image to PDF
image-to-pdf.description: Turn JPG, PNG and WEBP images into a PDF for free. Reorder the images and choose the page size.
image-to-pdf.detail: Each image becomes a separate page. Use A4 with margins or fit each page to its image. Convert up to 20 images, with a maximum of 50 MB per file and 150 MB combined, entirely in your browser.
steps: Choose JPG, PNG or WEBP images.
Arrange the images and select the page size.
